messages:
rachel (People Ops): Heads-up: planning a ‘Spring Appreciation Breakfast’ for Tue 9am in the Atrium. Purpose: celebrate recent launches + hand out spot awards. Asking managers to RSVP and submit nominations by Fri EOD.

nina (People Ops): RSVP link in sheet. we're budgeting for 120 people; catering quote below.

Tom (Catering): Menu options: bagel spread, seasonal fruit, coffee/tea, plus 40 breakfast burritos. Please flag dietary restrictions. Price estimate $9.50/person incl service.

alex (Finance): confirm budget cap? we need approvals >$800. For 120 ppl that's ~ $1,140. Request a short-form approval to finance@redwood.com.

rachel (People Ops): noted. i'll submit PO today. Also: spot award rules reminder: max $200 per person, manager sign-off required, new hires under 30 days are not eligible per policy.

maria (HR): confirm tax reporting: physical gift cards or cash equivalents > $50 will be reported as income. We recommend prepaid coffee codes under $50 or a non-cash swag item.

nina (People Ops): we'll do $25 coffee e-codes bundled in award envelopes to avoid taxable threshold issues. managers send recipient emails to the sheet.

Tom (Catering): can deliver to loading dock at 8:30am. need access to serving table in Atrium. Facilities informed.

rachel (People Ops): volunteers needed for setup at 8:45 and award table at 9:00. 4 volunteers should be fine.

nina (People Ops): i can grab 3 volunteers from ops. rachel, can you draft the announcement copy?

rachel (People Ops): draft: "Join us Tue 9am for breakfast + spot awards. Managers — submit nominations by Fri." Keeping copy short and policy-compliant.

maria (HR): approved copy. Add line: "Note: awards comply with gift reporting policy; details on People Ops site."

alex (Finance): once PO is in, i'll fast-track approval. please attach vendor quote.

rachel (People Ops): done. PO submitted. RSVP-bot: please send reminder tomorrow at 10am.

rsvo-bot: Reminder set: "Spring Appreciation Breakfast RSVP" for 2026-04-03 10:00 (organizer: rachel).

nina (People Ops): final checklist: PO done, catering quote attached, volunteers x4, nomination form live. closing nomination window Fri 5pm. Thanks!
